A resistor-loaded NMOS common-source stage removes the PMOS term. That should raise swing to about 1.6 V. Gain, f3dB and GBW margins are thin (~4%), so all three need checking."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":  (64e-6, 50e-6, 67.5e-6),   # NMOS drain current (power-limited: 1.8*(I+iref) <= 140uW)
    "Ln": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "RD": (13e3, 10.5e3, 15e3),      # load resistor to VDD (sets gain, BW, output DC)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    I, Ln, RD = p["I"], p["Ln"], p["RD"]

    vout = VDD - I * RD
    # NMOS: choose W so that Id(Vgs=vin, Vds=vout) = I (Id ~ linear in W); iterate on Vds.
    Wr = 10.0
    on = lut.op("n", Wr, Ln, vin, vout)
    Wn = max(0.42, Wr * I / on["Id"])
    for _ in range(2):
        on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)
        Wn = max(0.42, Wn * I / on["Id"])
    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)

    # Output capacitance estimate from a reference sizing at the same gm/Id.
    rn = lut.size("n", max(on["gm_id"], 3), Ln, I, vds=vout)
    cout = rn.cdd + rn.cgd

    # ibias sink: NMOS diode carrying IREF.
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(Wn, 3), Ln)
    n.R("RD", "vdd", "vout", RD)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    G = 1.0 / RD + on["gds"]
    A = on["gm"] / G
    f3 = G / (2 * PI * (cl + cout))
    gbw = A * f3
    power = VDD * (I + iref)
    swing = VDD - on["vdsat"] - 0.05   # resistor load reaches VDD; NMOS triode edge sets the bottom

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
```
